race.comment: MANUKAU (4) finally found some form last start at the fourth run of the campaign, scrambling home over this course and distance against the mares. Gets in with 2kgs less today after Grima's claim so a repeat performance is well within her sights. REGIMENTAL COLOURS (2) has been underwhelming in three runs this prep, the latest in a BM78 over this distance at Rosehill in Saturday grade. Cherry ripe after three runs back and is a winner here at this trip from her only attempt. Worth one more chance. TROOPER (6) returned from a five-month spell with a game all-the-way win over 1000m at Corowa recently. Has flourished since switching stables about nine months ago and he deserves his crack in the big smoke. STEEL MOVE (1) was only beaten 1.6 lengths when fresh from a spell over 1200m at Randwick on Cup Day. Second run under Joe Pride so can improve although the big weight is a worry. SOCIABLE (3) is a smart fresh performer who should be forward enough off an 11-week break.
